issues.fix:
Tried in var/fw (out/fix_cleaned_world.diff). acrossTies keeps the tie-centre place for kept parts only (membership uses kept[q.index]). A cleaned part takes its place from the world's planes in RANK_Q, which are f7ac37d's keys for it, as the verdict uses:
```
		if kept[p.index] then
			-- as now, ties counted where kept[q.index]
		else
			local kp = keys[p.index]
			local qx, qz = place(p.cx), place(p.cz)
			kp[3], kp[4], kp[5], kp[6] = abs(qx), qx, abs(qz), qz
		end
```
Results on var/fw:
- cs1, cs2 and the Ctrl+D cases read unchanged.
- Bit for bit with the tree as built on 136 fixtures, Parity's 200 and 11,130 plausible designs (every 3rd).
- The 3,264 fixture moves read as on the tree except X02's last bits (1.4e-17).
- Mirror images of the fixtures and Parity's 200 match the tree line for line; id shuffles differ only on A17; the 1,014-design finite digest equals the tree's.
- --quick: 732 pass, 0 fail with every pin below.
- luau-lsp passes A and B report nothing.
- Cost ×1.016 against the tree, within noise at 29–65 % load.

Its trade-off is the one f7ac37d has. A whole-design Z move that carries cleaned near copies of different materials across z = 0 swaps who owns their overlap (cs4.luau: mass −1.95e-4 at −0.01 Z; G unchanged; on the tree nothing changes).

The alternative, cleaned parts at place 0 (out/fix_cleaned_place.diff), also closes the hole and keeps moves exact. But then ids decide between cleaned round twins of one material: F2 with two Iron Dust Balls d 0.07 at x 0.2 and 0.23, ids swapped, gives COM x 4.2997e-4 against 4.2760e-4. The tree and f7ac37d show no such id effect.

Pins, tried (out/pins_invariance.diff):
- Invariance.spec 'T-DIF-04 a hidden part moves no other hidden part's place: F2 with two Dust specks, Iron and Steel, that overlap on its guard's front face owns the same volumes, mass and balance with a third of their size buried in the guard, or with the Steel one again in place'. Fails on the tree's source (part 5 owns 1.125e-4 → 6.75e-5); passes on fw and on place 0.
- 'T-DIF-07 (c) ids decide nothing between cleaned twins: F2 with two Iron Dust Balls 0.07 across ... whichever has the lower id'. Passes on the tree and fw; fails on place 0.

SPEC text to change:
- §4.3: '... then where it stands, a kept part among the kept parts it ties with and a cleaned one from the world's planes, so no id decides, and no whole design's move between kept parts'.
- §4.4, measure sentence: add 'a cleaned part stands from the world's planes, as in the verdict's rank, so no other part moves it; a whole design moved along X or Z can swap cleaned near copies it carries across x = 0 or z = 0, which moves only who owns their overlap (mass by the densities' difference), as at M3's commit'.
- §4.4 l.1095 and §17.2 S2, the parenthesis becomes '(the verdict's keys are each part's own; the measure places a kept part among the kept parts it ties with and a cleaned one from the world's planes)'.
- §16.18 RANK_Q row: add 'and a cleaned part's from the world's planes'.

- CONTACT_REACH = CONTACT_TOL + 1e-10: F2 with its pommel 0.0100000005 under its grip floats.
The existing pins cover only the upper sides (5e-9, 0.010000003).
